topic.title: OOP User Class
topic.description: Defines a User class with id, username, followers, and following attributes, plus a follow() method. A clean introduction to object-oriented programming.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Writing a class with __init__ to set initial state and defining instance methods that modify attributes. Understanding self as the instance reference.
learningNotes.challenges: Remembering to use self for every attribute access inside methods.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add an unfollow method, a bio attribute, and experiment with multiple User instances interacting.
